function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held use is prohibited while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers ≥ 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers < 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red = stop; green = go; yellow = caution.
• Stop signs require a full stop at the line or intersection.
• Yield signs: give right‑of‑way to vehicles already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks.
• “Yield to oncoming traffic” when turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No passing on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for all vehicles when a school bus stops with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended.
• Cannot pass a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or stop sign.
• No parking on sidewalks unless marked. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders < 18.
• Commercial vehicles: must follow specific weight and size limits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Penalties & Enforcement** | • Fines vary by offense; points added to driver’s record.
• Repeat offenders may face license suspension or revocation. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | ### How to Get Official Texts - **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website or through the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT). - **Texas Administrative Code** – For regulations and administrative rules. - **TxDOT Traffic Safety Division** – Offers brochures, videos, and safety campaigns. ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep a safe following distance** – especially on highways. 3. **Use your mirrors and check blind spots** before changing lanes. 4. **Stay alert for pedestrians and bicyclists** – especially in urban areas. 5. **Avoid distractions** – hands‑free only if you must use a phone. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check the latest updates, let me know!
